answer.answer: You will likely need to apply for a Student's Pass before you travel.  The ICA requires that a foreign student accepted for full‑time study submit the application 2‑3 months before the course starts and that the application can be filed while you are still in Vietnam.  You do not need to be in Singapore while it is processed, but you must enter Singapore after approval to complete the issuance formalities.  Prepare the required documents (passport, recent passport‑size colour photo, the school’s Registration Acknowledgement Letter, original documents and any official translations) and be ready to pay the non‑refundable S$45 processing fee.  Expect a processing time of up to one week (or two weeks if a visa is required).

Submit the application 2‑3 months before your NUS semester begins
Check that you are enrolled in an approved full‑time programme and that you do not already hold an exempted pass
Take a recent passport‑size digital colour photo (within three months)
Obtain the Registration Acknowledgement Letter from NUS
Prepare original documents and official translations for any non‑English papers
Pay the S$45 processing fee using an accepted method
Enter Singapore after approval to complete the pass issuance formalities
whatToPrepare: Original academic and identity documents plus official translations where required
Proof of payment method for the S$45 fee
warnings: Students cannot extend their stay in Singapore while a Student's Pass application is processing
You must not be in Singapore during processing; you need to enter after approval to collect the pass
Processing may take up to two weeks if a visa is required, so allow extra time

The listed portal domains are https://thithucdientu.gov.vn and https://evisa.gov.vn. Foreigners can declare temporary residence through the Vietnam Immigration portal.
